Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma
Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13241 of 2022
Applicant :- Smt. Kiran Srivastava

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Anuj Srivastava,Shakti Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 364 of 2009, under sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Anwarganj, District Kanpur Nagar, during the pendency of trial.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that in this case applicant is a widow lady and has falsely been implicated as being marginal witness in the disputed sale deed.

It is further submitted that after investigation final report was submitted by the police thereafter order for further investigation was made, as a result after investigation final report was submitted again by the police even then order for further investigation was also made and in the third time charge sheet Smt. Kiran Srivastava vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196826294/
1 was submitted by the I.O. though there was no any evidence on record to show the complicity of the present applicant.

entities.text: Smt. Kiran Srivastava vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Further submitted that the applicant could not appear before the learned court because no any process was received by her and now she is under apprehension of imminent arrest.

In case, the applicant is released on bail, she would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the trial, so requested for anticipatory bail.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perusal of record, there appears ground to grant anticipatory bail in favour of the applicant during the pendency of trial.
In default of any of the conditions, this order will automatically stand vacated.

Order Date :- 20.4.2023 Suraj Srivastav  Smt. Kiran Srivastava vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196826294/
